nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Physical Sciences
nodes.description: Physical Sciences — Grade 10 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Control test

nodes.title: Waves, Sound and Light
nodes.description: Physics strand: Waves, Sound and Light

nodes.title: Transverse Pulses on a String or Spring
nodes.description: Pulse, amplitude, superposition principle, constructive and destructive interference of pulses on a string or spring.

nodes.title: Transverse Waves
nodes.description: Wavelength, frequency, period, amplitude, crest, trough, in phase and out of phase. Wave speed: v = f × λ.

nodes.title: Longitudinal Waves
nodes.description: Compressions and rarefactions. Wavelength and amplitude of longitudinal waves.

nodes.title: Sound
nodes.description: Sound as a longitudinal wave. Speed of sound in different media. Echoes. Pitch and frequency, loudness and amplitude, quality and waveform. Ultrasound and medical uses.

nodes.title: Electromagnetic Radiation
nodes.description: Wave-particle model. Source and propagation of EM waves. Speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s. Properties of EM waves. EM spectrum (order, uses of each type, penetrating ability, dangers). c = f × λ. Photon energy E = hf = hc/λ.

nodes.title: Electricity and Magnetism: Electrostatics
nodes.description: Physics strand: Electrostatics

nodes.title: Charge and Charging
nodes.description: Positive and negative charges, neutral objects. Charging by contact (triboelectric effect). SI unit for charge (coulomb). Conservation of charge: Q = (Q₁ + Q₂)/2. Charge quantisation: Q = nq. Like and unlike charges. Polarisation of insulators.

nodes.title: Electricity and Magnetism: Electric Circuits (Introduction)
nodes.description: Physics strand: Introduction to electric circuits

nodes.title: Potential Difference, EMF and Current
nodes.description: Potential difference V = W/Q. EMF and terminal potential difference. Current strength I = Q/Δt. The coulomb. Conventional current direction. Ammeter and voltmeter connection. Resistance.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Control test

nodes.title: Electric Circuits (Continued)
nodes.description: Physics strand: Series and parallel circuits

nodes.title: Series Circuits
nodes.description: Same current throughout. Potential difference dividers. Total resistance: R_t = R₁ + R₂.

nodes.title: Parallel Circuits
nodes.description: Same voltage across branches. Current dividers. Parallel resistance: 1/R_p = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂. Solve circuit problems using R = V/I with up to 4 resistors.

nodes.title: Matter and Material: States of Matter and Kinetic Molecular Theory
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: Properties of matter and the kinetic molecular theory

nodes.title: Properties of Matter and Classification
nodes.description: Physical properties: strength, brittle/malleable/ductile, density, melting and boiling points. Mixtures, pure substances, elements and compounds. Diffusion and Brownian motion.

nodes.title: Three States of Matter and Kinetic Molecular Theory
nodes.description: Solid, liquid and gas states. Freezing, melting and boiling points. Heating and cooling curves. Kinetic Molecular Theory explanation of state changes.

nodes.title: The Atom
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: Atomic structure and electron configuration

nodes.title: Atomic Structure
nodes.description: Nucleus (protons and neutrons) and electrons. Atomic number, mass number, ions, isotopes, relative atomic mass. Standard notation for elements.

nodes.title: Electron Configuration
nodes.description: Aufbau diagrams. Electron configuration using spdf notation up to Z = 20. Atomic orbitals (s, p, d).

nodes.title: Periodic Table
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: The Periodic Table and periodicity

nodes.title: Names and Formulae of Compounds
nodes.description: Names and formulae of compounds using cation and anion tables. Metals, non-metals and metalloids. Conductors, semiconductors and insulators.

nodes.title: Periodicity Trends
nodes.description: Trends in atomic radius, ionisation energy, electron affinity and electronegativity across periods and down groups. Focus on Groups 1, 2, 17 and 18.

nodes.title: Chemical Bonding
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: Covalent, ionic and metallic bonding

nodes.title: Lewis Dot Diagrams and Covalent Bonding
nodes.description: Lewis dot diagrams. Covalent bonds and molecule formation. Relative molecular mass.

nodes.title: Ionic and Metallic Bonding
nodes.description: Ionic bonding and formula units. Relative formula mass. Metallic bonding.

nodes.title: Physical and Chemical Change
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: Physical vs chemical change and chemical equations

nodes.title: Definitions and Examples
nodes.description: Definitions and examples of physical and chemical changes.

nodes.title: Word and Balanced Chemical Equations
nodes.description: Word equations and balanced chemical equations with state symbols. Conservation of atoms and mass. Law of constant composition.

nodes.title: Representing Chemical Change / Quantitative Aspects (Introduction)
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: The mole concept, Avogadro's number and molar volumes

nodes.title: The Mole Concept
nodes.description: The mole, relative atomic mass, Avogadro's number and molar mass. n = m/M.

nodes.title: Molar Gas Volume
nodes.description: Avogadro's law. Molar gas volume at STP. Volume relationships for gases in reactions.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Control test

nodes.title: Quantitative Aspects of Chemical Change (Continued)
nodes.description: Chemistry strand: Concentration, empirical formulae and stoichiometry

nodes.title: Concentration
nodes.description: Concentration: c = n/V. Percentage composition. Empirical formula. Water of crystallisation.

nodes.title: Stoichiometric Calculations and Yield
nodes.description: Stoichiometric calculations. Theoretical yield and percentage yield.

nodes.title: Mechanics: Vectors and Scalars
nodes.description: Physics strand: Vectors and scalars

nodes.title: Vectors and Scalars
nodes.description: Physical quantities. Definitions of vector and scalar quantities. Graphical representation of vectors. Resultant using tail-to-head method for up to 4 force vectors in 1D.

nodes.title: Motion in One Dimension
nodes.description: Physics strand: Description of motion — position, displacement, velocity and acceleration

nodes.title: Frame of Reference and Position
nodes.description: Frame of reference. Position, distance and displacement.

nodes.title: Speed, Velocity and Acceleration
nodes.description: Average speed and average velocity. Acceleration: positive, negative and deceleration.

nodes.title: Instantaneous Speed/Velocity and Equations of Motion
nodes.description: Physics strand: Equations of motion and motion graphs

nodes.title: Instantaneous Velocity and Uniform Motion
nodes.description: Instantaneous velocity and speed. Distinction between uniform velocity and uniformly accelerated motion.

nodes.title: Motion Graphs
nodes.description: Position-time, velocity-time and acceleration-time graphs. Gradient and area interpretations for each graph type.

nodes.title: Equations of Motion
nodes.description: v_f = v_i + aΔt; Δx = v_i·Δt + ½·a·Δt²; v_f² = v_i² + 2a·Δx. Applications including stopping distance problems.

nodes.title: Energy (Introduction)
nodes.description: Physics strand: Gravitational potential energy and kinetic energy

nodes.title: Gravitational Potential Energy and Kinetic Energy
nodes.description: Gravitational potential energy: E_p = mgh. Kinetic energy: E_k = ½mv².

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Final examination: Paper 1 Physics (100 marks) and Paper 2 Chemistry (100 marks)

nodes.title: Energy (Continued)
nodes.description: Physics strand: Mechanical energy and conservation of energy

nodes.title: Mechanical Energy and Conservation
nodes.description: Mechanical energy: E_M = E_k + E_p. Law of conservation of energy. Conservation of mechanical energy. Applications: dropped objects, pendulum, roller coasters, inclined planes.

nodes.title: Revision and Final Examination
nodes.description: Revision of all Physics and Chemistry topics (wk 3–7). Final Exam: Paper 1 Physics 100 marks; Paper 2 Chemistry 100 marks (wk 8–10).

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Consolidation and revision of all Grade 10 Physics and Chemistry content.

nodes.title: Final Examination
nodes.description: Paper 1: Physics — all Physics topics (100 marks). Paper 2: Chemistry — all Chemistry topics (100 marks).
